I am old now, and this small piece of land near my home is what I have always farmed. I do not have money to buy chemicals or new seeds from the market, but I have my children and grandchildren to help, and my cows give me manure that I spread on this plot to help the maize grow. The rains have always been enough here, so I do not need to irrigate, and the plot is too small to waste money hiring workers or buying sprays. We will prepare the soil, plant our saved seed, weed it by hand when the rains come, and harvest when the cobs are dry.
